name: Bella Poarch
profileSummary: Denarie Bautista Taylor, known professionally as Bella Poarch, is a Filipino and American social media personality and singer. She rose to fame after creating the most liked video on TikTok in August 2020, in which she lip syncs to Millie B's song "M to the B". She is the fourth most-followed individual on the platform and the most followed person from the Philippines.
